sourceOfTruth: This file is the production launch evidence gate. External checks are marked READY only with provider, CI, runbook, or human sign-off evidence.

items.item: Production-like Meta webhook verification uses an explicit META_WEBHOOK_APP_SECRET
items.evidence: Repo-side validation exists in meta-bot-backend/src/config.js, meta-bot-backend/src/config/validate.js, meta-bot-backend/tests/config-validation.test.js, and .env.example. External Railway/provider proof that the deployed meta-bot-backend has META_WEBHOOK_APP_SECRET configured is not attached in this repo and was not available to Codex.
items.reasonMissing: Attach sanitized provider evidence for the deployed meta-bot-backend showing META_WEBHOOK_APP_SECRET is configured with the secret value hidden. Acceptable evidence: provider Variables screenshot with value redacted, deploy config export with values omitted, or provider CLI output showing variable presence only. Do not include the secret value.

items.item: Deployed Meta bot service is explicitly classified as production/staging
items.evidence: Repo-side validation and documentation require production/staging classification. External Railway/provider proof that the deployed meta-bot-backend is running with APP_ENV=production or staging and NODE_ENV=production is not attached in this repo and was not available to Codex.
items.reasonMissing: Attach sanitized provider evidence for the deployed meta-bot-backend showing APP_ENV=production or APP_ENV=staging and NODE_ENV=production. Do not include secret values.

items.item: Lead mutation routes require operator-level authorization or stricter
Production release gate requires website-lane tenant smoke
Provider backup policy and restore drill are proven before production launch
items.evidence: docs/runbooks/backup-restore-evidence-template.md defines the required evidence template only. It explicitly says the repo cannot create provider backups, verify provider snapshot policy, or prove restore success by itself. No filled provider backup or restore drill evidence is attached.
items.reasonMissing: Attach provider snapshot policy proof, latest backup timestamp no older than 24 hours at approval time, and a successful isolated restore drill record from the last 30 days. Include owner, approver, validation commands, RTO/RPO, and go/no-go decision. Do not include production secrets or raw customer data.

items.item: Paid launch has explicit pricing, payment/manual invoice, quota limits, cancellation/refund, and support terms
items.evidence: docs/launch/paid-launch-gate.md defines the paid-launch checklist and explicitly says this item must remain BLOCKED until approved paid launch evidence is attached. No approved pricing, payment/manual invoice, quota, cancellation/refund, support, or terms source of truth is attached.
items.reasonMissing: Attach the approved paid-launch source of truth covering pricing, payment/manual invoice process, quota/usage limits, over-limit handling, cancellation/refund terms, support response expectations, data export/offboarding, and owner/approver sign-off. This does not block unpaid controlled pilot, but it blocks paid and public launch.

items.item: Production readiness checklist is evidence-based and signed off
items.evidence: The evidence file and CI-readable launch gate exist, but this re-audit found provider/deployment evidence still missing for P0-001, P0-001-ENV, P0-004, and P0-005. P1 limited-launch proof is also still missing.
items.reasonMissing: Complete and attach real evidence for every P0 item that applies to the target launch, then record a fresh go/no-go approval with owner, date, approver, and evidence references. Do not sign off based on intention or unverified provider configuration.

items.item: Production rate limiting is shared across instances or fronted by provider/WAF proof for all v1 abuse-prone surfaces
items.evidence: docs/runbooks/v1-rate-limiting.md defines the v1 rate-limit contract and repo-side coverage. Production shared Redis/Upstash or provider/WAF proof is not attached yet.
items.reasonMissing: Attach provider or shared limiter proof covering auth/login, website widget public endpoints, Meta webhook ingress, inbox manual reply, source sync triggers, and any user-facing AI/runtime endpoints. Include owner, environment, policy names, thresholds, and a verification record proving the limiter is shared across instances or enforced at the edge. Do not include Redis passwords, webhook secrets, or WAF tokens.

items.item: V1 launch journey smoke covers auth, setup, Business Truth, website widget, inbox manual reply, and runtime health
items.evidence: ai-hq-backend/tests/v1-launch-journey-smoke.test.js defines the CI-safe e2e-lite launch journey and docs/runbooks/v1-launch-journey-smoke.md defines the staging/production browser smoke. Real staging/production run evidence is not attached yet.
items.reasonMissing: Attach a staging/production launch journey run record proving login/session, setup assistant, Business Truth/readiness, channels/widget setup, public widget load/message, inbox inbound item, manual operator reply, and runtime health/readiness. Include environment, release SHA, tester, timestamp, screenshots or CI log references, and any failure remediation. Do not include passwords, session cookies, widget session tokens, or provider secrets.

items.item: V1 data retention policy, dry-run/live cleanup evidence, and privacy exclusions are proven
items.evidence: ai-hq-backend/src/services/dataRetention.js and docs/runbooks/v1-data-retention.md define the repo-side retention policy and safe cleanup path. Production dry-run/live/schedule evidence is not attached yet.
items.reasonMissing: Attach a production-scoped dry-run output, approved live cleanup or scheduled job evidence, and reviewer sign-off proving tenant-scoped retention runs without deleting approved Business Truth/configuration. Do not include PII or secret values.

items.item: Production observability and alerting owner, contact, destination, and runbook are proven
items.evidence: docs/runbooks/v1-production-observability.md defines the vendor-neutral observability contract and required evidence. External provider alert delivery proof is not attached yet.
items.reasonMissing: Attach provider evidence that OBS_INCIDENT_OWNER, OBS_INCIDENT_CONTACT, OBS_ALERT_DESTINATION, and OBS_ALERT_RUNBOOK_URL are configured, and attach a successful test alert delivered to the incident contact. Do not include webhook secrets.
